goal: agent-ledger gets its first reliability checklist item, from agent-kit's roadmap R30: an entry format change keeps existing chains verifying.
changed: .agents/checklist.json holds one item, entry-format. It fires on a change to the entry model, canonical hashing, verify, receipts, the index or the S3 spec, and asks whether chains written before the change still verify.

claims.claim: The item fires on past commits that changed the entry format (e101dc0, 17ec81e) and stays quiet on a docs-only commit (9036afc).
claims.check: agent-kit's checklist.py --base C^ --head C under /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6; replay over 104 commits, fired on 24
claims.remaining: It has never caught a broken chain: none is on record. A replay of each format commit's verify on the chains before it found 0 broken runs.

claims.claim: The item's probe can be run as written: this checkout's verify passes on its own three sealed runs and on the ledgers of two sibling repos.
claims.check: ci/run_ledger.py verify, and verify --root on two sibling repos, on Python 3.12
claims.remaining: Whether an agent runs it. Nothing enforces the checklist, and CI does not read it.

release.none: no change to the ledger command; the file is read by an agent's verify-work
